en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a busy street scene in front of a large gate and traditional buildings. People in early 20th-century attire are visible, some sitting and some standing, with the focus on a significant entrance or gate. The image is overlaid with handwritten text in French on the margins. The printed caption at the bottom reads: 'Entrée du Gouvernorat, Rue Vafaié-Medjidieh.' The publisher 'Edit. Rollet, Lyon' is also mentioned.
